name: Aoto_lx.GRASS_CATEGORY_Jouteimon
source:
A young steeplejack apprentice from Blue Canyon Hamlet.
He's sort of reckless and has a strong sense of responsibility. He always tries hard whenever he does something.
He always had hostile feelings towards Clustania because they destroy human communities in the name of "Cleansing", but ever since he met [url=/c39368]Saki[/url], they've become a clear enemy.

[From [url=http://nisamerica.com/games/atq/]official site[/url]]
